cohort: 831 neonates admitted to the neonatal intermediate care unit of Kanti Children's Hospital, Nepal from January 2016 to December 2016.
finding: The prevalence of congenital heart disease (CHD) was 102.28 per 1000 admitted neonates, with atrial septal defect (ASD) being the most common type.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was spontaneous vaginal delivery in 71.8% of neonates with CHD, followed by elective C-section (14.1%) and emergency C-section (9.4%).
